capacity_gate: unchanged: final capture of at least 90% of zero-start mean-response energy
scope: Longer training-only optimizer diagnostic; identical starting parameters and solver. Not an independent restart.
optimizer: SciPy L-BFGS-B without box bounds, active coordinates only, fresh history
comparator: Completed 201-evaluation run; first 201 trial metrics and first 182 accepted iterates must reproduce before interpreting the extension.
primary_comparison: Last accepted training MSE at termination within 1001 total evaluations, including the repeated initial 201; unchanged 90% gate.
secondary_comparison: Best accepted training MSE, all trial and accepted histories, actual evaluation count and elapsed time; independent endpoint replay and numerical checks.
failure_policy: Abort on a nonfinite objective/gradient; preserve failing parameters and last accepted checkpoint. No silent retry or replacement of the declared run.
history_policy: Restart from original saved-950 parent and rebuild L-BFGS curvature by replaying prior work; no optimizer-state resume is claimed.
